name: Hanafi · Abu Hanifa / white twilight · draft
summary: Two-shadow Asr and white-twilight Isha. White twilight has no validated mapping in this draft; its boundary stays unavailable.
source_titles: Darul Iftaa · red and white twilight opinions

windows.preferred_guidance: Brightness marks the recommended Fajr period, allowing enough time to perform and, if needed, repeat the prayer before sunrise. No duration or brightness model is assumed.
Cooling and congregation can affect the recommended Dhuhr time. The app does not infer weather or a universal preferred cutoff.
Avoid delaying Asr until the sunlight weakens. This disliked-delay sign is not replaced by a fixed solar angle.
Pray Maghrib promptly. Star visibility marks a disliked delay in this account; the app does not model visibility.
This account recommends Isha before the first third passes and marks delay beyond half the night as disliked. The outer end is dawn.
